subject: Emerald City roundtable — venue availability, NDA & contract
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma@northbridgeevents.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: events@northbridgeevents.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Venue options & preliminary proposal for Emerald City roundtable

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for reaching out — we have a few private dining spaces in Seattle that match your brief (quiet, AV on-site, private entrance). I attached a short proposal with room photos, capacities, and sample menus. Key notes: 18-22 seated is the ideal range for the main private room; we can do a cocktail + seated hybrid for up to 30.

We usually require a signed venue agreement and a standard vendor NDA for events with restricted content; I can send both if you want us to hold the date.

Attachments: NB_venue_proposal_Seattle.pdf (9 pages)

Quick questions for your planning team:
- Final guest count target?
- Any dietary/allergy constraints we should flag?
- AV requirements (projector, microphone, livestream)?

Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow if useful.

Best,
Emma Clarke
Director, Client Events
NorthBridge Events
emma@northbridgeevents.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@northbridgeevents.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Venue options & preliminary proposal for Emerald City roundtable

Hi Emma — thanks for the quick reply and the proposal.

We'd like you to tentatively hold the Saturday, July 18th evening (arrival 6:30pm, program 7:00–9:00pm) for a private supper + short remarks. Tentative guest count: 20; we expect a handful of last-minute acceptances (target cap 24).

AV: laptop + HDMI + single wireless mic for remarks; no livestream.
Dietary: we'll collect diets and share a finalized list by July 8.

Please send over the venue agreement and the vendor NDA; need to route to our legal (cc'ing Evelyn Hart) for a quick review. If you have standard room-block pricing and minimums, include those in the contract.

Also cc'ing Aditya — he'll own guest outreach and RSVP tracking.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Venue options & preliminary proposal for Emerald City roundtable

Kim / Aditya — quick internal notes before we engage on contracts:

1) Legal check: I can review the NDA & venue agreement but will need at least 48 business hours. Please flag any non-negotiables (e.g., full indemnity, unusual insurance demands).
2) Guest list: Aditya please start a working invite spreadsheet (private) and mark who needs an NDA signed prior to attendance (we prefer public-sector/university guests to sign).
3) Budget: keep us within the $14k venue + catering estimate in the proposal; if NorthBridge requires a higher minimum, we'll evaluate.

Schema for invites: name / company / email / dietary / NDA required (Y/N) / RSVP status.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Customer Success & Events
Redwood Inference
evelyn@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@northbridgeevents.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final headcount window & NDA requirement — Emerald City roundtable

Hi Emma — following internal sync:

Final ask from our side before you proceed with a firm hold:
- Please confirm the private room reservation for July 18, hold capacity for up to 24 seats, and provide an updated cost estimate if the confirmed is 24 instead of 20.
- Send us your standard venue agreement and the vendor NDA. We need the NDA because several invitees are from regulated healthcare orgs and will request it up front.

I've attached a first pass invite spreadsheet (exec_invite_list_v1.xlsx) with 20 names; three of them (marked in column NDA required) will need to sign an attendee NDA prior to the event. Can you include a short attendee-NDA template we can route?

Please also confirm parking instructions and whether cloaking/security is available for attendee badges.

Thanks — cc'd Evelyn for legal timing.

–Kimberly
From: Emma Clarke <emma@northbridgeevents.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: events@northbridgeevents.com, Thomas Li <t.li@acmehealth.org>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final headcount window & NDA requirement — Emerald City roundtable

Hi Kimberly — all good, we have the room provisionally held for July 18 and updated the estimate for 24 covers. Attached is the venue agreement (NB_contract_2026_06_18.docx) and a short attendee NDA template (inline in the doc). Highlights:
- 50% deposit to secure the private room; standard cancellation 21 days prior for partial refund.
- Insurance: we ask for $1M general liability; we can accept Redwood's certificate.
- Attendee NDA: one-page mutual NDA for guests — editable for your legal if needed.

Parking: dedicated garage validation for 10 spots plus street permits; we can arrange additional valet at cost.

Let me know if you'd like NorthBridge to distribute the attendee-NDA link as a one-click DocuSign to the marked guests; we can do that and provide a signed roster back to you.

Attachments: NB_contract_2026_06_18.docx (5 pages)

Best,
Emma Clarke
Director, Client Events
NorthBridge Events
emma@northbridgeevents.com
